name: french-pronounce
title: French Pronounce
description: Pronounce selected French and English text with frdic and ElevenLabs, local privacy checks, and managed API keys.
author: you

preferences.name: randomFrdicPercentage
preferences.title: Random Strategy — Frdic Percentage
preferences.description: Chance of Frdic per pronunciation (0–100, default 50). ElevenLabs gets the remainder. Applies before cache lookup. Random mode does not fall back across providers.

preferences.name: strictPrivacyChecks
preferences.title: Local Privacy Checks
preferences.label: Block possible private data before sending text
preferences.description: Heuristically block emails, URLs, credentials, long digit strings and markup. Not a guarantee of privacy. The 175-character and control-character limits always apply.

preferences.name: elevenFrenchVoiceId
preferences.title: ElevenLabs French Voice IDs
preferences.description: One or more Voice IDs separated by commas (or newlines if pasted). Randomly choose one per playback. Blank uses FvmvwvObRqIHojkEGh5N. Each voice must be available to the API key.

preferences.name: elevenEnglishVoiceId
preferences.title: ElevenLabs English Voice IDs
preferences.description: One or more Voice IDs separated by commas (or newlines if pasted). Randomly choose one per playback. Blank uses bGnz83yTAb7caZSC7BBz. Each voice must be available to the API key.

preferences.name: elevenModel
preferences.title: ElevenLabs Model
preferences.description: Enter a model ID (letters, numbers, _, - or .). Examples: eleven_v4, eleven_v4_turbo, eleven_v3, eleven_multilingual_v2, eleven_flash_v2_5, eleven_turbo_v2_5. Blank uses eleven_v4. New IDs are sent without optional settings; check model access and documentation.

preferences.name: elevenSpeed
preferences.title: ElevenLabs Speed
preferences.description: Legacy Flash/Turbo/Multilingual only: 0.7–1.2, normal 1.0. Not sent for Eleven v4/v3; v4 does not support speed control.

preferences.name: elevenStability
preferences.title: ElevenLabs Stability
preferences.description: 0–1; default 0.65. Eleven v3 maps to the nearest supported 0, 0.5 or 1. Other models use the value directly.

preferences.name: elevenSimilarity
preferences.title: ElevenLabs Similarity
preferences.description: 0–1; default 0.75. Omitted for Eleven v3, which only accepts stability.

preferences.name: voicename
preferences.title: Frdic English Voice
preferences.description: Only affects frdic English pronunciation. Does not change ElevenLabs voices; those use the separate ElevenLabs English Voice ID.

preferences.name: translationEngine
preferences.title: Translation Engine
preferences.description: Optional translation shown as a toast. Choose None to skip translation.

preferences.name: deeplApiKey
preferences.title: DeepL API Key
preferences.description: Required only when Translation Engine is DeepL. Free keys usually end with :fx.

preferences.name: translationToastDurationSeconds
preferences.title: Translation Toast Duration (Seconds)
preferences.description: Optional. Leave empty for Raycast default behavior. Valid values are integers from 3 to 30.

commands.name: pronounce
commands.title: French Pronounce (Selected Text)
commands.description: Play pronunciation of the selected text; never reads the clipboard

commands.name: pronounce-english
commands.title: English Pronounce (Selected Text)
commands.description: Play English pronunciation of the selected text

commands.name: cycle-speech-strategy
commands.title: Cycle Speech Strategy
commands.description: Cycle fallback, frdic only, ElevenLabs only and weighted random; assign a global hotkey

commands.name: speech-strategy
commands.title: Select Speech Strategy
commands.description: View and select the current speech provider strategy

commands.name: manage-elevenlabs-keys
commands.title: Manage ElevenLabs Keys
commands.description: Add, edit, disable, delete and reactivate API keys; view usage and 7-day cooldowns

commands.name: toggle-translation
commands.title: Toggle Translation
commands.description: Toggle translation toast on or off at runtime
